prompts.prompt: Find a user by User Principal Name {userPrincipalName} and show their display name, department, and job title.

template.name: find-user-by-username
template.title: Find user by User Principal Name
template.description: Finds a user using their User Principal Name (UPN) and shows key details.

arguments.name: userPrincipalName
arguments.description: The user's User Principal Name (UPN), usually in email-address format.

prompts.prompt: Show all users in the department {departmentName}, including their display name and email address.

template.name: list-users-by-department
template.title: List users by department
template.description: Lists all users in the specified department, showing display name and email address.

arguments.name: departmentName
arguments.description: The department name to filter users by.

prompts.prompt: Find a user by their display name: {userDisplayName}, and show their full profile.

template.name: find-user-by-displayname
template.title: Find user by displayname
template.description: Finds a user by their full display name, returning full profile.

prompts.prompt: Show the manager of user {userPrincipalName}, including their display name, email, and job title.

template.name: get-user-manager
template.title: Get user’s manager
template.description: Retrieves the manager of a specific user, showing display name, email, and job title.

arguments.name: userPrincipalName
arguments.description: The User Principal Name (UPN) of the user whose manager you want to retrieve.

prompts.prompt: List all direct reports of user {userPrincipalName}, including their display name and job title.

template.name: list-direct-reports
template.title: List direct reports
template.description: Lists all users who directly report to a given manager.

arguments.name: userPrincipalName
arguments.description: The User Principal Name (UPN) of the manager.

prompts.prompt: Show all groups that user {userPrincipalName} is a member of.

template.name: list-user-groups
template.title: List user groups
template.description: Lists all groups the specified user is a member of.

arguments.name: userPrincipalName
arguments.description: The User Principal Name (UPN) of the user.

prompts.prompt: Find all users created since {createdSince}, showing display name, email, and created date.

template.name: list-recent-users
template.title: List recently created users
template.description: Lists all users created since the given date.

prompts.prompt: Show the assigned licenses of user {userPrincipalName}.

template.name: get-user-licenses
template.title: Get user licenses
template.description: Retrieves the assigned licenses and service plans for a specific user.

arguments.name: userPrincipalName
arguments.description: The User Principal Name (UPN) of the user.
